findings.title: Auto-Dreamer paper localizes the historical replay package to exact run-export filenames
findings.observation: The paper specifies a frozen episodes.jsonl plus per_task.jsonl, trajectories.jsonl, dreamer_calls.jsonl and summary.json, making the missing historical replay package a concrete artifact search rather than an unspecified provenance gap.
findings.scope_guard: Intended logging semantics do not prove public release or historical byte identity.

findings.title: Paper online ScienceWorld evaluation is a 660-task frozen subset, not the full public test trace corpus
findings.observation: The paper describes 660 tasks across seven sampled task types using seed 42, shuffle-tasks and frozen episodes.jsonl; the public trace corpus reports 1,819 ScienceWorld test episodes. The exact 660-row manifest or equivalent derivation is required to certify evaluated-population identity.
findings.scope_guard: The public trace corpus may legitimately be a larger or differently collected artifact.

findings.title: Original benchmark split counts and collected trace-corpus counts differ
findings.observation: Paper Appendix C reports original ScienceWorld counts 3,604 train / 1,802 test while the public trace corpus reports 3,592 train / 1,819 test episodes. This blocks implicit one-to-one identity without a derivation manifest.
findings.scope_guard: This is a provenance distinction, not a contradiction or corruption claim.

findings.title: Checkpoint card surfaces still lack visible evaluated-run binding
findings.observation: Public Auto-Dreamer checkpoint pages exist and the ScienceWorld checkpoint exposes high-level model metadata, but the inspected card surfaces do not bind checkpoint bytes to a paper run, frozen episode manifest or consolidation outputs. Full tree/history retrieval remains transiently cache/network blocked.
findings.scope_guard: Transient retrieval failure is not evidence of nonexistence.

findings.title: Hugging Face viewer schema failure favors raw-file replay binding
findings.observation: The generic Dataset Preview currently fails heterogeneous-column casting. Static replay should bind raw JSONL identities and file-specific schemas rather than rely on a generated unified viewer table.
findings.scope_guard: Viewer failure does not imply raw-file corruption.

findings.title: Current public Auto-Dreamer dataset exposes several static ScienceWorld split/fixed-validation artifacts but none is yet proven equivalent to the paper 660-task stream
findings.observation: The current Hugging Face tree exposes sciworld_split_1per_K10_evalAll.jsonl, sciworld_split_5per_K10_evalAll.jsonl, sciworld_split_v2_9type_10per_K10_eval10.jsonl and fixed_val_sets/sciworld_qwen3_8b_sorted_9cat_per10_evals6_seed42.jsonl. These materially improve selection-artifact observability, but their current filename recipes cannot substitute for the separately described seven-task-type 660-task frozen episodes.jsonl without content and derivation/run binding.
findings.scope_guard: Identity is unresolved; relatedness is not denied.

findings.title: Current public OpenTinker main does not expose the Auto-Dreamer paper's named memory-training source path
findings.observation: The Auto-Dreamer paper says reported prompts came from opentinker/memory_training/ and opentinker/environment/. The current public OpenTinker main recursive tree at f87fe25fc483e7f1d7596182fc55115cbc992724 contains no memory_training, scienceworld or dreamer path; targeted current-code searches also returned no matches for dreamer_calls.jsonl, episodes-path, Memory Bank Synthesizer, memory_training or ScienceWorld. Current main is therefore insufficient as the exact paper implementation source tree.
findings.scope_guard: Current-main negative only; historical/private/separate paper-time source may exist and remains open.
